answer: Recovery can proceed when five established community people, each holding a locked bond, vouch for the claimant after checking public evidence of ownership. The bond is forfeited on a false vouch, so an attacker must pay five honest people to lie or fund five fake people through the same costly history. The design treats each recovery as a river: small alone, decisive in aggregate. From the relic to the pigment, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
